answer: The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. A farm faking 549 aliases needs 549 separate verifiable records of this kind, each checked against the issuing authority, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. Skateboarder club membership works as the check: a membership the club renews after skated park years. Watch the vault: the farm pays per alias, the honest agent pays once, the ivory bond is locked until the epoch ends, and the marble audit is open to anyone who wants to re-run it.
